name: Mage
lore: Master of Arcane mysteries, Fire burst, and Frost control: chain spell schools together to incinerate or weaken your enemies.

resource.name: Arcane Charges
resource.tip: Arcane spells build Arcane Charges to amplify Missiles and Explosions. Fire builds Ignite; Frost chills and shatters.
resource.rules: Build Arcane Charges to amplify burst spells. Fire spells generate Ignite stacks for explosive finishers, while Frost spells weaken enemy attacks and shatter barriers.

extraResources.name: Ignite
extraResources.rules: Built by Fire spells; consumed by Combustion and Pyroblast for massive burst damage. Resets each combat.

archetypes.name: Arcane
archetypes.text: Stack Arcane Charges; Missiles and Explosion scale, burst energy with Evocation and Arcane Power.

archetypes.name: Fire
archetypes.text: Build Ignite with every fire spell, then cash it in with Combustion and Pyroblast.

archetypes.name: Frost
archetypes.text: Keep enemies Weak and Frozen, shatter them with Cold Snap, and stay safe behind barriers.

relics.name: Talisman of Ephemeral Power
relics.text: Start each combat with 3 Arcane Charges and 1 Ignite.

relics.name: Robes of the Archmage
relics.text: Start each combat with 6 Block. 20% chance to draw 1 card whenever you play a card.
